description: Add EXPO_PUBLIC_ENABLE_DEBUG environment variable to src/lib/config.ts for toggling verbose debug logging
steps: Read src/lib/config.ts to understand current schema structure
Add 'enableDebug' field to configSchema with z.boolean().default(true)
Add enableDebug?: boolean to RawEnv type
Update readRawEnv() to read process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_ENABLE_DEBUG (default true)
Export the enableDebug field in parsed config
Use config.enableDebug in logger.ts debug() method to control verbose output
acceptance_criteria: EXPO_PUBLIC_ENABLE_DEBUG defaults to true when unset
log.debug() calls are stripped when enableDebug is false
Config validation passes with the new field
verification: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_ENABLE_DEBUG=false in .env, verify log.debug() calls are suppressed
Set EXPO_PUBLIC_ENABLE_DEBUG=true (or unset), verify log.debug() calls appear
